svg.title: REDSOX winter Section 3 observed component spans
svg.desc: Twelve source-ordered stations on 22–23 February 2001. Southern half-peak local component spans are about 5.0 km at 20–60 m above bottom and 5.5 km at 40–80 m. The 40 percent threshold in the deeper layer extends to 12.6 km. Northern outcomes and all 10–50 m cases are unresolved. Missing casts, salinity support and all finite sensitivities are retained. These are not physical whole-current widths or annual ranges.
